Name: (CP) Hitme's Caroline Is Single (Immersive Caroline Divorce)
Author: Hitme11
Description:
[center][size=3][/size][/center][size=3]Second mod from my "Romance" collection. 
While I want to romance Caroline, I found romancing her immedietely a bit unimmersive for my liking, so I decided to write her a story. 

[b][color=#ff7700]FEATURES:
[/color][/b] ﻿- Added 4+ new vanilla-like events with different branch choices to expand her personality. (Caroline 2 hearts - 3 hearts - 4 hearts, Pierre 4 hearts) 
﻿[spoiler]
﻿ ﻿[b]Pierre's Stash (vanilla event) changed to 4 hearts: [/b]added new branch to explain Caroline's thought (she had already known about it before) [b] (ID: 16)[/b]
﻿ ﻿[b]Abigail's Clothes (vanilla event) changed to 4 hearts: [/b]added new branch to explain Caroline's thought about Abigail's action. [b](ID: 17)[/b]
﻿ ﻿[b]Caroline's Help: Caroline 2 hearts, visit Town on sunny Sunday, between 1pm and 4pm, not in Winter or Summer: [/b]Caroline helps Evelyn take care of the flowers around the townsquare. [b](ID: 9062981)[/b]
﻿ ﻿[b]Caroline's Favourite Book: Caroline 3 hearts, visit Museum on sunny Friday, not in Summer: [/b]Jas and Vincent ask about Caroline's favourite book. [b](ID: 9062982)[/b]
﻿ [color=#ffd966][b]﻿Caroline/Robin collab: visit Town from 6pm to 8pm, has Robin Is Single installed, dating both Caroline and Robin, 10 hearts with Robin and Caroline, has rabbit;s foot in your inventory, must have seen 1 of the 4 vanilla group dating events: [/b]Robin and Caroline bait you into going out with them. [b](ID: 906291001)[/b][/color]
﻿[/spoiler]
﻿- Added 5+ new divorce events, each with different choices. Process this storyline will eventually make her romancable. Can be turned off. (Caroline 5 hearts - 7 hearts - 9 hearts - 10 hearts - 8 hearts (post-divorce), 10 hearts with Pierre and Caroline (post-marriage))
[spoiler]
﻿ ﻿[b]﻿Pierre's Night Talk: Caroline 5 hearts, Pierre 1.5 hearts, visit Town between 7pm and 9pm, everyday except Friday: [/b]Pierre talks with you about his future plans, while Abigail is sneaking out of the shop. [b](ID: 9062986)[/b]
﻿ ﻿[b]Abigail's Confront: Caroline 7 hearts, Abigail 1.5 hearts, visit Pierre's shop between 9am and 12am, every sunny day except Friday, must have seen previous event: [/b]Caroline talk to you about her dream in the past, her life before meeting Pierre. [b](ID: 9062987)[/b]
﻿ ﻿[b]Caroline's Confide: Caroline 9 hearts, visit Pierre's shop between 9am and 6pm, Caroline must be there, must have seen previous event and must have unlocked the Sunroom (seen the Sunroom event):[/b] Caroline invite you to have tea session in her room, tell you about her relationship with Abigail lately and about how she met Pierre in the first place. [b](ID: 9062988)[/b]
﻿ ﻿[b]Caroline's Divorce: Caroline 10 hearts, visit Town between 7pm and 9pm, every sunny day except Friday, Wednesday, must have seen previous event: [/b]You hear Caroline and Pierre argueing in the shop, or follow Abigail to the river. For immersive purpose, she'll move out of the Valley and will visit occasionally. Spoiler: it'll change her schedule so that her spawn room will be moved outside of Valley instead of the Seed Shop, her schedule also has some small adjustments so that she won't hangout in the shop anymore.[b] (ID: 9062990)[/b]
﻿ ﻿[b]Caroline's Aftermath: Caroline 8 hearts, visit the Forest between 7pm and 9pm, must have seen previous event, [color=#ff7700]5 days after the Divorce Event[/color]:[/b] She want to talk about her life choices and ask you a final question.[color=#f1c232] [b]You're now able to romance her. (ID: 9062991)[/b][/color]
﻿ ﻿[b]Pierre's Bar Talk: Caroline 10 hearts, Pierre 10 hearts, visit the Stardrop Saloon at Friday night, from 6pm to 9pm, not festival day, Pierre and Abigail must be there, must have seen the previous event: [/b]Pierre has a good talk with you, you know more about Pierre's story and motives. He finally opens up and decides to move on from the divorce with Caroline. [b](ID: 9062992)[/b]
﻿[/spoiler]
﻿- Dynamic schedule depend on her marriage status.
﻿- Rewrote her dialogues, including her festival dialogues and reactions.
﻿﻿- Added Caroline's marriage dialogues, marriage schedule, new spouse room and spouse area.
﻿- 1.0.1: Added Caroline portraits compatibility switch so you can use this mod with other portrait mod. (Check the configuration).
﻿- 1.0.3: Added Caroline's nose.

[b][color=#ff7700]COMPATIBILITY:[/color][/b]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿: compatible at playable state. Added 1 new events to further explain Abigail's true identity if SVE Mature Events is on.
﻿[spoiler]
﻿ [b]﻿Wizard's Reveal: After marry to Caroline, you will receive a letter from the Wizard telling you to visit him at the tower: [/b]Wizard reveals that Abigail is not his/her child, automatically change the pronouns and name to Rasmodia if Rasmodia is installed.
﻿[/spoiler]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cuter Outfits[/url]﻿: compatible. You should not turn off Caroline changes in SCO because I patched directly into it.
﻿﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]Romancable Rasmodius[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romancable Rasmodia[/url]﻿: should be playable.
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15532]sy_mokarin Datable (and Marry) Caroline[/url]: not compatible, if you want to make her datable right away, I'd recommend using their mod instead, as this mod requires you to play a moderate amount of time before you can marry her.
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url]: [color=#ff7700][b]I didn't check that mod out yet, but base on its description, it should not be compatible as Jellonip said in the comment section that they muted a lot of SVE event and added their own version of them, so play with your own risk. A﻿lternatively, you can turn off this mod SVE events so that it won't conflict with RRRR, but the storyline of 2 mods might be not be in tune with each other.[/b]
[/color]
[b][color=#ff7700]INSTALLING INSTRUCTION:[/color]
[/b] ﻿- Put [CP] Caroline Is Single into your mod folder.
﻿- Check the configuration before playing.
﻿- Enjoy!

[b][color=#ff7700]FAQ:
﻿ ﻿[/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4][b][color=#ff7700]Q: How can I know this mod is working or not?[/color][/b]
[b] ﻿ [/b]﻿A: If you're intending to play with fresh safe, there is a small change in Caroline's introduction, she'll said that Abigail is not very hospitable. 
[color=#ff7700] ﻿ ﻿[b]Q: Why does my friendship with Caroline drop down by 2 hearts after the divorce event, is it a bug?[/b][/color]
﻿ A: No, it is intentional, after a messup marriage, I'm sure no one ever want to jump into another relationship.
[color=#ff7700] ﻿ ﻿[b]Q: Are the divorce events unskippable?/Is there a consequence for skipping them?[/b][/color]
﻿ A: Most of them don't, but there is one important event that can change your outcome with her, so I make it unskippable to ensure the story play correctly.
[color=#ff7700] ﻿ ﻿[b]Q: Can I somehow marry her without going through the entire storyline?[/b][/color]
﻿ A: Yes, there is an option for that.[color=#f4f4f4] [/color]You can turn off the divorce storyline and can still marry her with that option on if the events somehow bother you.
[color=#f4f4f4] ﻿ [/color][b][color=#ff7700]Q: What's is your writing style?[/color][/b]
﻿ A: I don't know, I'm not an English speaker so some of the dialogue may sound weird to you. If you see any grammar errors or just don't find my dialogue/writing suit your taste, feel free to comment your suggestions on the comment page, I'll definitely consider them! P.S.: sorry if my bad grammar ruined your immersion while playing this mod.
[/color] ﻿ ﻿[b][color=#ff7700]Q: Can I replay events from this mod?[/color][/b]
﻿ ﻿A: As for right now, I don't have a built-in support nor want to make the events replayable, because Caroline status in this mod is tracked by the event seen flag. However, you can always use debug command (debug ebi <EventID>) to replay them, but I don't recommend using the debug to skip the stage of the story, it will likely break something. Each event ID can be found using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]Event Lookup[/url] or checking the spoiler contents above.
﻿ [b][color=#ff7700]﻿Q: Is it safe to remove/install mid-game?[/color][/b]
﻿ ﻿A: You can install it mid-game, but remove it while still playing the same save will log out some error about missing locations, they don't actually do anything really, but may annoy you somehow. However, I do not recommend remove this mod while still marrying to her.
﻿ ﻿[b][color=#ff7700]Q: Where is she after divorce/How can I find after the divorce event/What is her schedule changes?[/color][/b]
﻿ [color=#f4f4f4]﻿A: I kept the schedule similar to her vanilla version, with some small changes for immersive purposes, notable ones are that she will hangout at the forest instead of Pierre's shop, or go to bus stop at the end of day. You can check her schedule that day with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19305]Schedule Viewer[/url].
[/color]
